prompt: Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with neck strain after a rear-end collision. The patient had 22 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1096; do not mention it.)
text:
The patient presented following a rear-end motor vehicle collision with complaints of neck pain, stiffness, and intermittent headaches radiating from the occipital region. Examination revealed reduced cervical range of motion, particularly in rotation and extension, with paraspinal muscle tenderness and mild guarding. Neurological screening was within normal limits, with no motor deficits, sensory changes, or reflex asymmetry. Imaging was not indicated based on clinical findings. The diagnosis was cervical strain with associated myofascial pain.

Over the course of 22 visits, the patient received a combination of manual therapy, soft tissue mobilization, therapeutic exercise focused on deep neck flexor and scapular stabilization, and postural education. Pain levels decreased steadily from initial presentation, and range of motion improved progressively across the treatment period. Headache frequency diminished, and the patient reported improved tolerance for daily activities and computer work. At the most recent evaluation, the patient demonstrated near-full cervical range of motion with minimal residual tenderness. The patient was discharged to an independent home exercise program with instructions to return if symptoms recur.
